summary: Re-test of visual/theme fixes at 390x844 mobile viewport confirmed all three fixes are working. FIX #1: Bottom tab bar labels ('Teklif', 'Katalog', 'Geçmiş', 'Müşteri', 'Firma') are fully rendered without truncation (widths 22-32px, no overflow); active tab uses gold #C9A227 (rgb(201,162,39)), inactive uses muted slate. FIX #2: History card action buttons (Düzenle 93px, PDF 93px, WA 93px, trash-icon 40px) fit in a single row within the 362px card width with no truncation. FIX #3: Navy & Gold palette applied correctly — header background rgb(11,37,69) = #0B2545 navy with white brand text and gold bottom border; Firma picker button uses gold accent (border #C9A227, subtle gold tinted bg); Grand total banner has navy background rgb(11,37,69); PDF CTA (pdf-download-btn) uses gold background #C9A227. Regression: all 5 tabs navigate without crashes/errors; existing TEST_UI_E2E_Customer quote (540,00 $) still displays correctly in Geçmiş with 'Beklemede' status and all four action buttons operable.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts cleanly defines navy/gold tokens plus goldSoft/goldBorder and keeps 'accent' aliased to navy for backwards compatibility — good refactor pattern that avoided sweeping renames.

_layout.tsx uses fontSize 9.5 + paddingHorizontal 2 + tabBarItemStyle which allows all five Turkish labels (including diacritic 'Müşteri', 'Geçmiş') to fit at 390px width — verified via getBoundingClientRect (widths 22-32px, no overflow).

history.tsx actionBar uses flex:1 on the three text buttons and fixed width:40 on the icon-only trash button; shortening 'WhatsApp' to 'WA' was the correct minimal fix to eliminate truncation at this viewport.
TopHeader has borderBottomWidth: 3 with gold color as an accent stripe — matches PRD spec of gold accent under navy.
Same pre-existing non-blocking console warning from iter_2 present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (originates from react-native-web/Ionicons internals, not app code).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 visual fixes verified, 5/5 tabs regressed clean)
